spec.description: cAdvisor does not have a native "down" metric. This panel is using the container_last_seen metric, but looking back in time to check if it has recently been scraped for that metric, if it has failed the last 1h; it is considered "down". This means the counter will reset after a certain amount of time passes.
spec.title: Currently DOWN on '$instance'
